items.title: Jubilant FoodWorks shares jump 6% as Domino's, Popeyes drive Q1 growth
items.description: Following the quarterly results, MOFSL has upgraded Jubilant FoodWorks to 'Buy' from 'Neutral' and set a target of ₹625.

items.title: LEAP India shares list at 4% premium over IPO price, miss expectations
items.description: LEAP India share price opened at ₹166 on the BSE, up 4.40 per cent over the issue price. Meanwhile, on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), it listed at a 4.34 per cent gain at ₹165.90.

items.title: Most Tata stocks fall for 3rd day post-Chandra's exit; TMPV top loser
items.description: Heavyweights, including Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Tata Steel, Tata Communications, Trent and Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles traded lower, with losses up to 6 per cent in some counters.

items.title: Technocraft Ventures makes strong debut, shares list at 34% premium
items.description: Incorporated in 1998, Technocraft Ventures is an engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) company engaged in public infrastructure projects.

items.title: Jio Fin, M&M, Shriram Finance: Mirae Asset Sharekhan analyst decodes charts
items.description: Muthuselvaraj M, technical research analyst at Mirae Asset Sharekhan says Mahindra & Mahindra, Jio Financial Services and Shriram Finance stocks look favourably placed on the technical charts.

items.title: Tata Motors PV falls nearly 6% after weak Q1; Jefferies flags JLR headwinds
items.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported a 78.54 per cent decline in net profit to ₹859 crore. The company had posted a net profit of  ₹4,003 crore in Q1FY26.

items.title: Nifty Metal tanks 3% in two days on profit-taking; NALCO, SAIL top losers
items.description: Analysts say the decline in metal stocks is mainly due to profit-taking by investors. The index is up 15 per cent year-to-date (YTD).

items.title: LG Electronics rallies 9%; analysts bullish on margins, market expansion
items.description: LG Electronics India saw its net profit rise 27.2 per cent in Q1 FY27 to ₹653 crore on the back of revenue growth and margin expansion.

items.title: Microcap 250 index hits 52-week high; Manorama, Balu Forge surge up to 15%
items.description: At 10:09 AM on Friday, the Nifty Microcap 250 index was up 0.39 per cent at 26,236.65, compared to a 0.18 per cent decline in the Nifty 50 index.

items.title: Honasa Consumer rallies 5%, hits 52-week high on healthy Q1 results
items.description: Honasa Consumer stock hit a 52-week high of ₹501.55; the stock has more-than-doubled or zoomed 102 per cent from its 52-week low of ₹248.55 touched on December 11, 2025.

items.title: Gold may consolidate after sharp rally; resistance at $4,500: Mirae Asset
items.description: Mirae Asset expects gold to find good support in the dips. After a brief consolidation, it is expected to test resistance at $4,500. Support is at $4,300/$4,200-$4,220.

items.title: Oberoi Realty, 360 One, ICICI AMC: Midcaps at inflection point; what next?

items.title: ZEEL shares jump 8% as SAT stays Sebi order, allows fundraise from promoter
items.description: Zee had sought permission to proceed with its proposed ₹3,143 crore preferential warrant issue and a relaxation in the 14-day window for completing the process.

items.title: Voda Idea soars 4% on huge volume in weak market; up for 6th straight day
items.description: In the past six trading days, Vodafone Idea's share price rallied 12 per cent after the telecom company reported June 2026 quarter (Q1FY27) earnings.

items.title: Silver eyes $68 as Fed rate-hike bets ease, says Mirae Asset ShareKhan
items.description: Silver price outlook: Praveen Singh of Mirae Asset ShareKhan said that spot silver is expected to consolidate its gains after rising a whopping 12 per cent last week.
